# Quantelite

> Quantelite is a premium 1:1 online tutoring practice specializing in AP and IB Mathematics, calculus, statistics and the mathematical foundations of AI and machine learning. It is led by Akash Gupta (B.Tech, IIT BHU; Master's in Artificial Intelligence, IIT Kharagpur), who has mentored 200+ students across 6+ countries. All sessions are live, 1:1 and online, scheduled across North American, UK and European, Middle East and Asia-Pacific time zones.

## Programs

- [AP Calculus AB & BC tutoring](https://thequantelite.com/ap-calculus-tutoring)
- [AP Precalculus tutoring](https://thequantelite.com/ap-precalculus-tutoring)
- [AP Statistics tutoring](https://thequantelite.com/ap-statistics-tutoring)
- [IB Mathematics AA & AI tutoring (SL/HL)](https://thequantelite.com/ib-math-tutoring): in IB, "AI" means Applications and Interpretation
- [University calculus tutoring](https://thequantelite.com/calculus-tutoring): customised to the student's university syllabus
- [University statistics tutoring](https://thequantelite.com/statistics-tutoring): customised to the student's university syllabus
- [Mathematics for machine learning, including linear algebra](https://thequantelite.com/math-for-machine-learning)
- [AI & machine learning for kids and teens (ages 10-18)](https://thequantelite.com/ai-ml-for-kids): skills-based, not tied to any school board
